description: Defines the OX_Admin_UI_Controller_Request class, a PHP class modeling an HTTP request object for use within the Revive Adserver project, providing methods to handle request parameters, server info, and request metadata.

classes.name: OX_Admin_UI_Controller_Request
classes.description: A PHP class representing an HTTP request, with methods to access request parameters, request method, server info, base URL, and request URI.

methods.name: setParam
methods.description: Sets a user-defined parameter for the request object.

methods.name: getParam
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value with priority: user-defined, $_GET, $_POST.

methods.name: getParams
methods.description: Returns all parameters, merging user-defined, $_GET, and $_POST with user-defined taking precedence.

methods.name: setParams
methods.description: Sets multiple parameters at once from an array.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method used for the request.

methods.name: isPost
methods.description: Checks if the request was made via POST.

methods.name: isGet
methods.description: Checks if the request was made via GET.

methods.name: getServer
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the $_SERVER superglobal, or the entire array if no key is specified.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Constructs and returns the base URL for the request.

methods.name: getRequestUri
methods.description: Returns the request URI, accounting for platform differences.
